title: Killing of Thule Society members, April 1919
summary: Peter Levenda tells of Killing of Thule Society members, April 1919, about 1919 at Munich, Germany, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: an assassination of members of the Tula Gazelle shaft uh on April 30th in 1919.

plain: A researcher and author, Peter Levenda, tells on Jesse Michels's podcast of the killing of members of the Thule Society, a secretive German group, in Munich on April 30, 1919. Levenda brings it up as part of his account of the strange roots of later Nazi beliefs.
